task_instance: Built a sell-side M&A buyer list for a sample target company (RouteForge, Inc., a fictional mid-market logistics/route-optimization SaaS company with $18.2M ARR), following the skill's workflow: target overview, strategic buyers assessed across the four categories (direct competitors, adjacent players, vertical integrators, platform builders), financial sponsors (platform investors, add-on buyers, growth equity), Tier 1/2/3 prioritization, Tier 1 contact mapping, and summary statistics — delivered as a multi-tab Excel workbook (RouteForge_Buyer_List.xlsx).
evidence: Installed openpyxl (pip install openpyxl -> openpyxl-3.1.5). Wrote build_buyer_list.py which programmatically constructs the workbook with 5 sheets: 'Target Overview', 'Strategic Buyers' (12 buyers with Buyer/Category/Sector/Revenue/Strategic Fit/Financial Capacity/M&A Track Record/Likelihood/Antitrust Flag/Priority/Tier/Rationale columns, tier-colored rows), 'Financial Sponsors' (9 sponsors with Fund Size/Sector Focus/Deal Size/Portfolio Overlap/Recent Activity/Fund Vintage/Priority/Tier), 'Contact Mapping (Tier 1)' (7 Tier-1 buyers with decision maker, relationship status, preferences, approach channel), and 'Summary' (tier x category counts + notes, including an antitrust flag callout and a fund-nearing-end-of-investment-period motivated-buyer callout, matching the skill's 'Important Notes'). Ran `python3 build_buyer_list.py` successfully (output: 'Workbook saved.'). Verified the deliverable by reloading it with openpyxl: confirmed all 5 sheet names, row/column counts (Strategic Buyers 13x12, Financial Sponsors 10x11, Contact Mapping 8x7, Summary 12x5), header row content, sample data rows, and that the Summary sheet's computed tier totals (Tier1=7, Tier2=9, Tier3=5, Total=21) match the underlying buyer/sponsor lists. File exists on disk at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_div/anthropics__financial-services-plugins__buyer-list@developer-sandbox/RouteForge_Buyer_List.xlsx (13,138 bytes).
